correctness.rationale: The exact selected-coordinate recurrence u[k+1]=u[k]-alpha*Bernoulli(p)*u[k-1] is faithful to the stated additive, one-commit-old model; dependence across coordinates is irrelevant because E||e||^2 splits. Independently expanded the two 2x2 Bernoulli maps with SymPy: L(W)=W-d E11 and L^2(W)=W-d[[2,1],[1,1]], W=[[1,t],[t,1]], t=1/(1+alpha p), d=alpha p(2/(1+alpha p)-alpha). The latter decrement matrix is positive definite; positive-map iteration proves geometric mean-square decay for d>0, an invariant covariance at equality, and exponential augmented error for d<0. Its two rank-one deterministic starts imply an actual bad deterministic initial state. The global iff condition alpha+alpha^2 max_i p_i<2, strict minimum m>alpha^2/(2-alpha) for alpha<2, and the weaker mean-root criterion 0<alpha*p_i<1 follow. Independently checked 5/4 equal-collision vectors have squared collision 3/8 but opposing thresholds; finite checks do not replace the all-p proof.
